title: Waku² Monster
overview:
Raising sim + puzzle. Raise a monster that's yours alone!

Waku Waku Monster is a falling-block puzzle game with a monster to raise. Move your character along the top of the field and drop blocks, clearing them by linking three or more of the same color. Chain clears to fill your attack gauge, then strike to send nuisance blocks onto your opponent's side, or press the button in time to defend against an incoming attack. Blocks you soak up can be fed to your monster, and the colors you give it shape how it changes.

- Choose from 12 monsters and more, each attacking in its own way according to its attribute
- Head-to-head play for two players
- Memory backup save

育成＋パズル。キミだけのモンスターを育てよう！
